responsibility: Defines the alternative fence and atomic load/store patterns used when the RISC-V Ztso extension is enabled. It specializes memory barriers and plain atomic loads/stores for the stronger TSO model, using shorter sequences than RVWMO where possible while still honoring seq_cst requirements, and thus serves as the Ztso-specific companion to sync-rvwmo.md within the backend’s atomic memory-model support.
